summary: Alpha is the primary deterministic fixture. It exercises rendered notes without relying on network data. Its high star count establishes hub ordering.
use_case: Use it to test deterministic Starduster rendering.

summary: Beta is the second deterministic fixture. It shares an author and topics with Alpha. Its star count keeps ordering observable.
use_case: Use it to test author and topic hubs.

summary: Gamma is a machine learning fixture. It completes the shared topic threshold. Its ordering remains deterministic across reruns.
use_case: Use it to test category and topic hubs.

summary: Delta is a second machine learning fixture. It completes the author hub threshold. It has fewer stars than Gamma.
use_case: Use it to test author hub thresholds.

summary: Epsilon is a single-author command-line fixture. It must not create an author hub. It keeps below all dynamic hub thresholds.
use_case: Use it to test threshold controls.
